item.name: Log in (run this folder first)
L-01 Log in as the host - 200, token saved

exec: pm.test("answers token, token_type and expires_in", function () { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.token_type).to.eql("Bearer"); pm.expect(body.expires_in).to.be.a("number"); });
pm.test("the account is a HOST and no hash is shown", function () { pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql("HOST"); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).to.not.include("password"); });

item.name: Accounts
A-01 Register a new account - 201, a PLAYER, no password in the body

exec: // A new school ID on every run, so the collection can run again without db:reset.
pm.test("the account is a PLAYER", function () { pm.expect(user.role).to.eql("PLAYER"); });
pm.test("no password and no hash in the answer", function () { const text = JSON.stringify(pm.response.json()); pm.expect(text).to.not.include("password"); });

item.name: A-02 Same school ID again - 409 SCHOOL_ID_TAKEN
A-03 Same email, new school ID - 409 EMAIL_TAKEN
A-04 Asking for ADMIN comes back PLAYER - 201

exec: pm.test("role is PLAYER even though the body asked for ADMIN", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql("PLAYER"); });

item.name: A-05 Weak password - 400 VALIDATION_FAILED
A-06 Wrong password - 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS
A-07 Unknown school ID - 401, the same body as A-06

exec: pm.test("the body is identical to the wrong-password answer", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("failedLoginBody")); });

item.name: A-08 Log in with the new account - 200
A-09 Login with a body that is not text - 400

exec: pm.test("it is the new account, without a hash", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.school_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newSchoolId")); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body)).to.not.include("password"); });
